title: Cross-validate: Tunnel auth parity
description: Verify Python/Rust/Zephyr produce identical tunnel-auth validation results given same CBOR input. Use vectors from hgwq.4.
notes: Cross-language parity gate now drives finalized 23-message/26-POST/13-decapsulation tunnel_authorization fixture through independent Python, Rust, host C, and Zephyr/QEMU consumers. Exact canonical bytes/pubkey/IID/route hashes and allowed/denial/CoAP outcomes are asserted, including replay, revoke/fresh rearm, root rotation, clock rollback, malformed/noncanonical/duplicate data, boundaries, direction and address scopes. Proven parity fixes: C and Rust now classify duplicate protected alg keys as malformed rather than unsupported-algorithm; Rust retains explicit revoked replay-floor state and reports expired matching grants as expired rather than unauthorized. New scripts/check-tunnel-auth-parity.py runs freshness, Python oracle/schema, exact Rust and UBSan host-C gates with optional QEMU. Validation: aggregate gate passed; Python 5/5; Rust 3/3 + clippy -D warnings + rustfmt; host C UBSan 1/1; pristine Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 3/3 including complete corpus, PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL; Ruff/mypy/py_compile/deterministic fixture generation/diff checks passed.
